findings.description: `recachedTokens` was exported earlier in this PR for `retro-signals.utils.ts`, but this commit removed that import; its only caller is now `addCalls` in the same file, so drop the `export`.

`sizeBucket: c.sizeBucket ?? ''` is a fallback no input can reach: `carryRows` always passes `sizeBucket` as `bucketOf`, which never returns an empty label. It exists only because `ToolCarry.sizeBucket` is now optional (general.md §Altitude / YAGNI: no fallback for a state the surrounding code already guarantees).

`classRows` keeps a second `transcripts` map grouped by class next to the class+model+effort `buckets`, then re-filters all buckets per class (`[...buckets.values()].filter((b) => b.class === klass)`). Grouping the buckets by class once would remove the parallel structure.

The comment "Workers and the conductor write under the dir the project's windows run on; the console under the operator shell's own" explains both entries of the dirs list, but the second entry now lives in `claudeDirsOf`, and `pup retro` calls it with no comment. Move the who-writes-where explanation onto `claudeDirsOf`'s JSDoc.

The new `writeRetro` JSDoc sentence ("The Markdown file is for reading and the JSON one for the next tool that reads it, so a retro always leaves both") restates what the code and return type already show, and names a consumer that does not exist yet. Drop it and keep the owner-only/same-day-replacement sentence.
